page.overview:
Who is First Fire Lord?

The future founder of Fire Nation lived in the era of the constant wars between island warlords. The cruelest of them, Toz, had ruled centuries before the first Fire Lord, yet his actions echoed for very long, including the presence of child-kidnapping dark spirits, the Kemurikage.

The man was a master firebender with a strong spiritual connection to fire, earning him the moniker of the "Fire Lord". he led an army of his own to bring the warlords to justice and eventually united the majority of the Fire Islands. The warlords and their families retained part of their powers, including the land and even the armed troops.

Eventually, even further parts of the archipelago that remained autonomous and diverse accepted the new government, like Sun Warriors territories, Bhanti Island, or the Sibuyan chain.

In his age, the Fire Nation was highly spiritual compared to the later days. It was ruled by the council of the Fire Sages, the religious order descended from the Bhanti people, led by the Fire Lord in the Fire Nation Capital from the Fire Nation Royal Palace with the support of the several advisors. The most trusted of them was honored with a burial in the Garden of Tranquil Souls after their death, a place reversed for deceased royalty and high-ranking court members.
